text: The contacts sidebar load callback first runs AbPanelLoad, then registers density and font sizing. AbPanelLoad sets the results row class and columns synchronously, but schedules ChangeDirectoryByURI on a later event turn to keep initial display quick. Thus the reordered registration follows widget setup; it does not wait for address-book data to load. Unload cleanup remains in the existing path. This is a local readiness boundary, not a blanket window-startup rule. No runtime or accessibility execution.
title: Contacts pane registers display settings after widget setup but before deferred contacts loading
